tags.text: There are few guitarists whose playing is more deeply woven into the fabric of Canadian rock than Al Connally, A founding member of Newmarket's own Glass Tiger, Connelly helped shape the sound of a band that exploded onto the international stage with its 1986 debut. The Thin Red Line. The quadruple-platinum album produced enduring hits including "Don't Forgot Me (When I'm (gone) " and " someday, " both of which reached the Top 10 on the U.S. Billboard charts. Glass Tiger went on to sell more than five million albums worldwide, earn a Grammy nomination, win five JUNO Awards, and share stages and studios with artists Including: Tina Turner, Rod Stewart, Bryan Adams, Journey and Cheap Trick. The band was Inducted into Canada's Walk of Fame in 2023 and the Canadian Music Hall of Fame In 2026.
Thank you for supporting original music!

For the Sunset Sessions, Connolly brings that remarkable history into an intimate, stripped-back selling, joined by Craig Riley (percussion) and Mike Oresco (bass). Together, the trio will revital songs and stories from a career spanning more than four decades, offering a rare opportunity to hear new original music and experience the musicianship behind some of Canada's most recognizable rock records up close and personal.
